outcome: Maternal complications (moderate anemia, hypertensive disorders, ante partum haemorrhage, post partum haemorrhage, fever, urinary tract infection, local sepsis, ICU admission)
Fetal complications (IUGR, LBW, prematurity, respiratory distress, neonatal jaundice, sepsis, NICU/SNCU admission, neonatal death)
cohort: The study included pregnant adolescent women, primarily primigravida, admitted to Lakhimpur Medical College and Hospital in Assam, India.
finding: Fetal and maternal complications were found to be significantly higher among adolescent pregnant women.
mod_finding: The study observed that 87.95% of adolescent women delivered babies via normal vaginal delivery.
